context: A mom and her young son trace their family's pet timeline
purpose: Teach: ひとつひとつ/案の定/暫く/流石/ずーっと/飼っ/つづける/掛かる

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえママ、うちって今までずーっと動物飼ってるよね？
lines.en: Hey Mom, we've always been keeping animals, right?
lines.style: Curious child opening a nostalgic family conversation warmly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうね、最初はおじいちゃんちの金魚から。アルバム、ひとつひとつ見ていこっか。
lines.en: Yeah, starting with grandpa's goldfish. Let's look through them one by one.
lines.style: Warm maternal tone inviting shared reminiscence with affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: わっ、この犬すごく大きい！何年くらい飼ってたの？
lines.en: Whoa, this dog is huge! How long did we keep him?
lines.style: Excited childlike surprise mixed with genuine curious questioning.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ハチはね、十五年もずっと一緒だったの。流石に長生きしてくれたわ。
lines.en: Hachi was with us for fifteen whole years. He really lived long.
lines.style: Soft proud tone laced with quiet maternal nostalgia and gratitude.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 次の猫ちゃんは？ぼく覚えてないけど、暫くいたんだよね？
lines.en: What about the next cat? I don't remember, but she was here a while?
lines.style: Tentative young voice piecing together fuzzy childhood memories carefully.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ミケは三年だけ。病気の治療に時間が掛かるから、毎週病院通いだったのよ。
lines.en: Mike was only three years. Treatment took time, so weekly vet visits.
lines.style: Reflective measured tone explaining a bittersweet practical reality gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: そっか…じゃあ今のポチも、ずっと大事にしつづけるね、約束！
lines.en: I see... then I'll keep cherishing Pochi forever too, I promise!
lines.style: Earnest determined childlike promise spoken with sweet sincerity.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。案の定そう言うと思った。流石、ママの息子ね。
lines.en: Yeah. I figured you'd say that. Truly my son, aren't you.
lines.style: Tender knowing laugh blended with proud maternal affection warmly.
